updates.summary: Implemented the tagged Markdown dashboard, Jekyll HTML build, GitHub Pages workflow, and local verification.
Recorded GitHub's account-level billing lock after every Actions job was refused before execution.
Scheduled the dashboard to rebuild every morning at 08:00 Asia/Bangkok.
Moved the execution backlog into validated JSON and made the HTML dashboard derive its current state from that ledger.
Started an independent Vercel deployment path for the JSON-driven Jekyll dashboard.
Completed and verified the Vercel build and daily refresh function; production remains blocked until the repository is authorized and imported into Vercel.
Made the index page the explicit current development update, with live status counts and priority-ordered work derived from the JSON backlog.
Verified the production Vercel dashboard, then added Tailwind CSS and automatic repository, commit, branch, and commit-message metadata to the status page.
Started adapting the Markdown lifecycle to the repository's existing Rails CI, JSON backlog, documentation dashboard, and single-owner review model.

Implemented checked lifecycle artifacts, shared working agreements, project standards, CI and dashboard integration, and templates; the documentation build passes, while the full gate exposed two transient system-test synchronization failures.
Recorded two full-suite browser timing failures at the shared post-sign-in synchronization point; each affected system test passes when rerun alone, so retries were not added to the gate.
Started replacing the fragile post-submit timing assumption with an explicit wait for the authenticated path and rendered catalog.
The synchronized sign-in helper passed the complete system suite three consecutive times and then passed as part of the full local CI gate.
Full local verification passed: lifecycle checks, RuboCop, dependency audits, Brakeman, 473 Rails tests with 4,002 assertions, seed replanting, and both system tests.
Published and verified the repository-native development flow, policy pages, templates, and live monitor on Vercel revision 7e3e12a.
Closed the shared sign-in synchronization defect after repeated system-suite passes, a green full local gate, and publication of commit 7e3e12a.
Added a vendor-neutral monitoring and tracing application to the lifecycle, including signal flow, required views, correlation and privacy contracts, and the Operate exit gate.
Renamed the canonical system development flow as the master file and updated its current backlog evidence link.
Started connecting the master lifecycle, skill indexes, authoring template, and all declared skill relationships into one validated documentation graph.

Connected all 41 current Markdown documents, linked all 34 skills and their declared relationships, translated the canonical skill library to English, added persistent validation, and passed the rendered documentation build and full local CI gate.
Started correcting publish-time link failures found during the pre-apply audit and adding rendered-site link validation.

Restored unrelated lifecycle documents, made all new navigation targets publish-safe, retained the legacy flow URL as a compatibility redirect, verified 1,146 local links across 61 rendered pages, and passed the full local CI gate.
Started exposing the documentation skill library to Codex through a repository-local routing skill without installing anything globally.
Created the repository-local skill router, connected it to project guidance, and passed both the official skill structure check and the project documentation gate.
Passed the rendered documentation build, 1,147 local-link checks, and the full local CI gate; repository-owner diff review remains before completion.
Started reducing AGENTS.md to a single canonical master-flow reference and aligning its documentation validation.
Reduced AGENTS.md to the canonical master-flow reference, aligned README and CLAUDE guidance, and passed source and rendered documentation checks.
Passed the full local CI gate after the AGENTS.md cleanup; repository-owner diff review remains before completion.
Started creating a role-by-role operating guide for lifecycle entry, ownership, skills, delegation, gates, and handoffs.
Created and connected the all-roles workflow guide, covering 14 roles, all 9 phases, all 34 skills, delegation rules, gates, and handoffs; source and rendered documentation checks pass.
Passed the full local CI gate for the all-roles workflow guide; repository-owner content review remains before completion.
Started creating a privacy-safe external proposal template for new-feature and feature-improvement requests with human product triage.
Created and connected the external feature proposal and template directory; source validation and 1,309 rendered local-link checks pass across 64 pages.
Passed the full local CI gate for the external feature proposal template; repository-owner content review remains before completion.
Rechecked the proposal documentation and full local CI gate: 64 rendered pages, 1,310 links, 473 Rails tests, and 2 system tests pass.
Connected the six lifecycle directory indexes and five existing Claude skills to their project entry points; all 79 project Markdown files now form one connected local-link graph.
Started documenting an outcome-driven, dual-track roadmap method with explicit problem, metric, priority, capacity, and human-decision boundaries.
Added the roadmap methodology, decision cycle, dependency-aware prioritization, capacity heuristic, milestone sequencing, and agent delegation boundaries to the project development flow.
Verified the roadmap methodology through source validation, 1,324 rendered local-link checks across 64 pages, and the complete local CI gate.
Started replacing the one-time all-document connectivity audit with a persistent project Markdown graph gate.
Added repository-wide local-link and connected-component validation for root documentation, docs, and hidden project skills, and made bin/docs enforce it.
Verified one connected component across 79 Markdown files and 620 local source links, 1,324 rendered links across 64 pages, and the complete local CI gate.
Started adding skill-first navigation from every documented skill to the project development flow and master flow.
Updated all 34 skills, the authoring template, and both skill indexes with ordered skill-to-development-flow navigation and added persistent order validation.
Verified all 35 detailed skill and template navigation blocks, 657 source links, 1,364 rendered links, and the complete local CI gate.
Started making skill-to-flow navigation and flow-to-skill phase routing complete and bidirectional.
Linked every detailed skill to all three flow guides, added all 34 phase-routed skills to the project flow, and made validation enforce every flow-to-skill edge.
Verified bidirectional links between all 34 skills and all three flow guides, 754 source links, 1,464 rendered links, and the complete local CI gate.
Started turning Roadmap Milestone 1 into a concrete Plan-to-Measure example without inventing its blocked human decision.

Created and connected a worked reliable-account-recovery example with phase artifacts, skill routes, gates, candidate invariants, verification evidence, operational guidance, and the current human handoff.
Verified the worked roadmap example across 80 source Markdown files, 1 connected graph, 65 rendered pages, 1,517 rendered links, and the complete local CI gate.

Prepared draft ADR-0002 with current Postmark, Amazon SES, Resend, and no-change options; selection rules; security and privacy trade-offs; proposed fitness functions; and the human decision checklist.
Verified ADR-0002 across 81 source Markdown files, 1 connected graph, 66 rendered pages, 1,542 rendered links, 2 lifecycle records, and the complete local CI gate.
Prepared proposed ADR-0003 for a pinned, loopback-only, ephemeral Mailpit development inbox while withholding the container dependency until human acceptance.
Started implementing the human-accepted Mailpit decision with pinned, loopback-only, ephemeral local capture while leaving production SMTP unchanged.

Verified the pinned Mailpit container, loopback-only ports, ephemeral storage, Rails development SMTP capture, unchanged test adapter, and absence from production configuration; human Tier C diff review remains required.

Passed the complete local CI pipeline with the documented machine-specific Mailpit port overrides: setup, documentation validation, style, security audits, 473 Rails tests, seed replant, and two system tests.

Repository Owner approved the Tier C diff after reviewing the verified loopback-only, ephemeral Mailpit implementation; MAIL-004 is complete while production SMTP remains separately blocked on MAIL-001.
Started integrating the existing Slack signal, channel, governance, and async-handoff policy into the canonical, project, and all-role development flows.

Added Slack routes across the master, project, and all-role flows, including repository-first lifecycle status notifications such as proposed-to-accepted, message contracts, CI/release/incident routing, privacy boundaries, and explicit non-ChatOps controls; source, rendered, and complete local CI gates passed.
Repository Owner approved the Slack development-flow documentation, including repository-first lifecycle status messages such as accepted; DOCS-012 is complete.
Started implementing an outbound-only, default-branch Slack mirror for validated backlog and lifecycle status transitions, using the human-approved DOCS-012 policy as acceptance intent.

Implemented and verified a non-blocking main-only Slack status mirror that waits for all six independent jobs, detects append-only backlog and lifecycle transitions including accepted, excludes backlog titles, escapes dynamic fields, and never reads Slack; 479 Rails tests, 4,107 assertions, two system tests, rendered links, and the complete local CI gate passed.

Reverified the missing-owner safety path and complete local CI pipeline: seven focused detector tests with 121 assertions, 480 Rails tests with 4,123 assertions, two system tests with 20 assertions, documentation validation, style, security audits, and seed replant all passed; human Tier C diff review remains required.

Repository Owner approved the Tier C diff after reviewing the verified outbound-only, main-branch lifecycle status mirror; SLACK-001 is complete while live delivery remains credential-gated by SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_STATUS_CHANNEL.

Repository Owner approved the Tier C diff after reviewing the verified repository-local Codex skill router, its project-only scope, minimum-skill selection, and non-delegable human decision boundaries; AGENT-001 is complete.
Product Owner rejected ADR-0002 without selecting a production email provider or providing a replacement direction; MAIL-001 remains blocked and MAIL-002 is not authorized to start.
Repository Owner approved the Tier C diff after reviewing the minimal AGENTS.md reference to the canonical system development flow; AGENT-002 is complete.

Repository Owner approved the all-roles workflow guide after reviewing its role playbooks, lifecycle handoffs, skill packs, delegation rules, Slack handoff rules, and repository handoff template; DOCS-005 is complete.

Repository Owner approved the worked Milestone 1 development-flow example after reviewing its roadmap framing, lifecycle artifacts, role handoffs, skill routes, verification evidence, and outcome measures; DOCS-011 is complete.
Repository Owner approved the cross-linked lifecycle skill routes after reviewing the Plan, Design, Spec, Code, Test, Build, Release, Operate, and Measure phase mappings; DOCS-010 is complete.
Repository Owner approved the skill directory links to the project development flow, role guide, master flow, and canonical skill library; DOCS-009 is complete.
Repository Owner approved the connected Markdown graph enforcement after reviewing the validator's repository-wide link resolution and single-component result; DOCS-008 is complete.

Repository Owner approved the roadmap methodology after reviewing outcome-driven dual-track Agile, WSJF/Cost of Delay prioritization, vertical slices, governance gates, capacity guidance, and outcome measurement; DOCS-007 is complete.

Repository Owner approved the external feature proposal template after reviewing requester intake, privacy and confidentiality safeguards, untrusted external content handling, internal triage, ownership, prioritization, and acceptance criteria; DOCS-006 is complete.
Drafted ADR-0004 to defer production email while preserving local Mailpit; MAIL-001 remains blocked pending Product Owner acceptance or a replacement direction.
Product Owner accepted ADR-0004; MAIL-001 is complete as the resolved deferral decision, while production email remains intentionally unconfigured.
Blocked production email implementation under accepted ADR-0004; no provider or credentials are authorized.
Blocked real-mailbox verification because production delivery remains deferred under accepted ADR-0004.
Drafted SPEC-0001 for topic 1-1, What AI is, and actually does; implementation is awaiting Product Owner and instructor review of objectives, invariants, and acceptance criteria.
Product Owner and instructor accepted SPEC-0001; M2-001 implementation is authorized to begin for topic 1-1.

Implemented topic 1-1 bilingual content, topic-scoped quiz and coding grading, locale-aware lesson rendering, focused tests, browser system tests, documentation validation, and focused style checks; instructor and student content review remain required.

Repository Owner approved the verified topic 1-1 implementation after reviewing the bilingual lesson, topic-specific assessments, server-side grading, focused tests, and browser walkthrough; M2-001 is complete.
Drafted SPEC-0002 and queued the AI1101 foundation-course content increment for Product Owner and instructor review.
